text:
amy: Heads up — Deploybot failed to publish the new canary image to eu-east. It rejected the push due to a provenance metadata mismatch. Holding the change window for now.
josh: logs?
amy: paste from deploybot below:

```
> deploybot: publish failed for repo=redwood/runtime:staging-20260321-rc2 -> eu-east
> reason: provenance-annotation mismatch across mirrors: build_id differs (build-9765 vs build-9764)
> action: reject to prevent ambiguous pinning
```

maria: hmm, that sounds like the build metadata stamping race we saw last month. Is this the same CI job?
kevin: @amy do we know whether the artifact content (digest) differs or just the provenance annotation? If digest same, we can still promote the digest and skip the noisy metadata.
amy: payload digest is identical across regions. only the `build_id` annotation is different — looks like a flaky step in the image-labeler job that ran in parallel.
josh: so safe option = pin to the digest we already validated in staging and force promote that digest to canary instead of relying on tag name. That avoids retagging.
amia: (typo) maria: agree with @josh. We should avoid recreating images. Can we do a manual promote via deploybot with `--force-pin`?
kevin: deploybot can do manual promote but we need approvals for change-window exceptions. Release notes?
amy: proposal: 1) hold automated tag push; 2) manual promote of validated digest to eu-east canary using deploybot (no new publish); 3) annotate release notes that we pin digest X as fallback; 4) postmortem to fix image-labeler race.
amia: maria: please add a short blurb to release notes about the pin and follow-up. I can schedule the postmortem.
kevin: criteria for rollback if something flakey shows up? Suggest we keep the previous stable digest pinned for 2 hours as an automatic fallback and monitor errors > 1% for 10m triggers rollback.
amy: sounds good. I'll kick off the manual promote now and request approvals.
deploybot: @amy manual promote request received: `promote --digest sha256:abc123def456 --target eu-east/canary`
deploybot: approval required from 2 approvers in eng-releases or release-manager.
oncall-bot: change-window currently open until 10:30 UTC. If we proceed with manual promote, please ack here so SRE can lift the hold for that digest. :white_check_mark:
josh: ack from me.
maria: ack — will add release-note blurb: "Canary promoted to sha256:abc123def456 due to publish metadata mismatch; no new image was built."
kevin: I'll stand by with rollback runbook ready. If error rate >1% across canary in 10m, we revert to previous sha256:aaa999bbb111 and alert.
amy: done — manual promote succeeded, deploybot confirms promote to eu-east canary. We'll monitor and follow up with a postmortem on the labeler race. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
